description: This file defines several Pydantic data models used for handling portfolio-related requests and responses in a trading backend service.

classes.name: PortfolioAllocationRequest
classes.description: A data model for requesting portfolio allocations, containing a list of allocation dictionaries.

classes.name: PortfolioAllocationResponse
classes.description: A data model for responding to portfolio allocation requests, including status and message.

classes.name: ManualRebalanceRequest
classes.description: A data model for requesting manual rebalancing actions, containing a list of action dictionaries.

classes.name: ManualRebalanceResponse
classes.description: A data model for responses to manual rebalance requests, including status and message.
